All 24 backend tests pass (15 regression + 4 iter2 + 5 iter3 cmd flow + 1 installer). Frontend verified: RemoteControl component renders inside the Devices Connect modal with every expected data-testid (remote-control, remote-key-input, remote-send-text-btn, remote-key-enter/tab/esc/backspace/delete/win/cad, session-end-btn). Mock fallback (live-screenshot-mock) shown correctly when device has no agent, with 'DEMO · sem agente conectado' badge and input correctly disabled. Agent page now shows the new Windows auto-installer one-liner (with installer URL + selected token interpolated) and the PyInstaller .exe block; token picker updates the command.

issues: At 1920x1080 the modal (status bar + screenshot mock + controls + end-session row) extends below the viewport so 'Encerrar sessão' button is not visible without scrolling. Consider max-h-[90vh] + overflow-y-auto on DialogContent, or use a smaller screenshot aspect.

data-testid='cmd-win-installer' and 'cmd-exe' are placed on the 'Copiar' button only, not on a wrapper containing the code block. Moving the testid to the wrapping container would make it easier for tests to read the rendered command. Functional behaviour is correct.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings still present from iter 1/2.

OPTIONAL: Add max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto on the Connect modal DialogContent so 'Encerrar sessão' is always reachable.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~945 lines — well over the 700-line threshold; agent/devices/sessions/users routers should be extracted.

GET /api/agent/installer/windows and /api/agent/script are completely public (no auth, no token). Anyone scanning the public URL can fetch the installer and the agent.py. Low risk because the script itself requires a valid access-token at register-time, but consider rate-limiting or making these endpoints require an access-token in the query string.

POST /api/sessions/{id}/command does not verify that the operator actually owns the session (any authenticated user can queue commands on anyone else's active session). Consider checking sess['operator_email'] == user['email'] or require role/RBAC.

POST /api/agent/commands/poll marks all returned commands 'delivered' BEFORE the agent confirms execution. If the network drops between poll and ack the commands are silently lost (status stays 'delivered', never 'done'/'failed'). A retry or visibility-timeout pattern would be safer.

agent_commands collection has no index on (device_id, status) — poll query will full-scan as it grows. Add db.agent_commands.create_index([('device_id',1),('status',1),('created_at',1)]) in on_startup.

CommandIn allows action='hotkey' with empty keys list (no validation); pyautogui will then throw on the agent side. Add a pydantic validator that requires keys for hotkey/key_press and text for key_type.
